Extreme low angle on a lone hiker in a red jacket standing on a misty mountain ridge at dawn; the ground suddenly trembles, small rocks bounce and roll past the hiker's boots, the hiker stumbles and looks back.

Wide shot: the whole forested mountain behind the tiny hiker slowly lifts out of the fog, it is the shell of a colossal ancient tortoise, trees and waterfalls on its back, thousands of birds scatter into the sky.
Close-up of the colossal tortoise's enormous ancient eye slowly opening, wet and amber, the tiny figure of the hiker in a red jacket reflected in it, mist drifting across the scaly skin.

Aerial drone shot: the colossal forest-covered tortoise walks slowly through a sea of clouds at golden sunrise, the tiny hiker in a red jacket standing on its shell with arms raised, sun rays breaking through.
